summary: I'm a Backend Engineer with over five years of experience building and evolving scalable systems for fintech, banking, enterprise and media platforms. I specialize in Node.js and TypeScript, designing cloud-native services on AWS and Azure using serverless, microservice, event-driven and distributed architectures. My work spans enterprise APIs, financial integrations, video-processing workflows, observability, automated testing and code-quality practices. I have contributed to technical decisions, backend modernization and team leadership while keeping reliability, security and maintainability central to delivery. I focus on practical architecture: systems that are clear to operate, resilient in production and aligned with real business requirements.
